name: How do I choose the right foundation contractor for my ADU project?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right foundation contractor for my ADU project?

acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing an ADU foundation contractor, look for experience with local regulations and varied site conditions. Verify their licensing, insurance, and request references or examples of past ADU projects. Consider a contractor like Hometelligent Inc. that serves your specific area, such as Fremont or Pleasanton, as they will have familiarity with local permitting requirements and common soil types, which can streamline the project.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a foundation contractor with ADU experience, proper licensing, and local knowledge, especially for specific areas like Fremont or Pleasanton.
